_read_this_first: The foundation: every statement the rest of the work rests on, each with the file that derives it and a text anchor that must still be present. Before writing physics in a note, a chapter or a script, read this file - not a memory of a conversation. CANON/foundation_check.py refuses a push when an anchor has moved (the foundation changed and this file did not) or when a retired phrasing reappears. Adding or changing an entry is deliberate: change the book, then this file, then say so in the development log.

entries.statement: Every irreversible transition from quantum superposition to classical record pays kT ln2 per bit to the nearest encoding surface at the local temperature.
entries.anchor: Every irreversible transition from quantum superposition to classical record pays $\kB T\ln2$ per bit

entries.statement: The held state is a balance of restore and loss. Over any interval a held site is lost with probability f and a lost one restored with probability g, so eps = f/(f+g) and E_hold = kT ln(g/f). The interval need not be a division: in a dividing cell much of the loss happens as the DNA is copied, in a cell that has stopped dividing loss and restore are upkeep. The held error is set by the RATIO, not by the number of copies. Division sets only how fast the balance is reached, about 1/(f+g) intervals.
entries.anchor: \section{The held state is a balance of restore and loss}
entries.layer_note: the kinetics of the core, stated substrate-free: any interval, dividing or not

entries.statement: eps = f/(f+g); (1-eps)/eps = g/f; E_hold = kT ln(g/f).

'Copy error' is a RETIRED term. It is NOT what IAM measures and NOT what sets A, IAM-A or the gauge. What is read is the held error eps, the error of the balance between writing (on SAM) and erasing (on oxygen and 2-oxoglutarate) at the held sites, independent of division: neurons do not divide and hold the same balance (author, 2026-10-14).
entries.anchor: \textbf{Not} what IAM measures, and \textbf{not} what sets $A$, IAM-A or the gauge.

entries.statement: E_hold = kT ln[(1-eps)/eps], read from the held error; 3.41 kT at Loyfer read level (3.41-3.77 across data sets).
entries.anchor: read from the held error as $\kB T\ln[(1-\varepsilon)/\varepsilon]$

entries.statement: eps_0 = 1/(1+e^{phi M}) = 0.032 with phi M = E_hold = 3.41 kT, the holding energy measured across 56 healthy cell types.
entries.status: derived from the measured holding energy

entries.statement: IAM-A = eps / eps_pred(L): the measured held error over the held error the sample's own loose share L predicts on the self-reference line (each sample against its own reference; no outside reference). Commissioned 2026-10-17 on healthy blood CD8 T cells, whole-genome bisulfite, band v1 0.779-1.055. The earlier form H(eps)/(P_cell H(eps_0)) against a frozen per-cell position P is retired to a development flag.
entries.layer_note: an instrument, not a law: it reads the core's terms in one substrate through one named pipeline

entries.statement: H_min = H(eps_min), the floor set by M and temperature alone (no dependence on copying or division), is the lowest error a system can hold before thermal kicks win. It is NOT the denominator of A and not 1: it sits below 1 at H_min/healthy reference.
entries.status: DERIVED (the floor; M alone fixes it)
entries.anchor: It is not the denominator of $A$ and not 1

entries.statement: M = E_drive / kT, the drive ratio: the energy a substrate spends per irreversible write in units of the thermal noise quantum at its operating temperature, with NO ln2. Dimensionless, fixed by the physics of the drive, not a reading of a person: every human cell at 37 C has the same M. For the cell, ATP's cytosolic free energy of hydrolysis 54 kJ/mol at 310.15 K gives M = 54000/(8.314462618 x 310.15) = 20.94. Present CMOS logic runs a few hundred kT per switch. It sets the operating regime and, with the architecture, the IAM floor. The only quantity named Mahaffey.
entries.status: DERIVED from the drive energy (a calculation, not a fit)

entries.statement: phi is the fraction of the drive that ends up holding one site: phi x M = E_hold. With M = 20.94 and E_hold = 3.41 kT, phi M = 3.41 and eps_0 = 1/(1 + e^{phi M}) = 0.032. A lever that changes the drive changes M; a lever that changes how much of the drive reaches the site changes phi; both act on the holding energy through this product.
entries.status: definition in force (phi M is the measured holding energy)

entries.statement: The gauge has three marks and they are not the same kind of thing. BOTH ENDS ARE FIXED BY PHYSICS AND DERIVED: the floor by thermal kicks against one ATP, the ceiling by a coin flip at every identity site. ONLY THE MIDDLE - the healthy reference - IS MEASURED, on purified healthy cells of the same type. A = reading / healthy reference; A = 1 is the cell working as itself; above 1 it makes more error than when healthy.
entries.status: DERIVED (both ends) and MEASURED (the middle only)
entries.anchor: The two ends of the gauge are fixed by physics: the floor by thermal kicks against one ATP,

entries.statement: eps_min = 1/(1+e^M) from M and temperature ALONE - the error one ATP of holding energy still allows against thermal kicks, NOT a copying error, and the same whether the cell divides or not (the floor, a calculation); eps_0 = 1/(1+e^{phi M}) with phi M = 3.41 kT measured across 56 healthy cell types (the middle, measured, phi = 0.1628 of one ATP); H_min = H(eps_min); H_ref = H(eps_0). Ceiling: no energy holding the site, error 1/2, one bit per site, set by physics.
entries.status: DERIVED from the holding energies; only eps_0's energy is measured

entries.statement: On the methylated channel the reading rises with loss ONLY while those sites stay above beta = 1/2. Past that point the specimen reaches the ceiling - one bit per site - and then reads LOWER again as the sites keep falling, so the reading is not monotone past the ceiling. The chain flags any specimen whose methylated sites average below one half and tells the reader to read the mean beta instead (conductor_v3._ceiling).
entries.anchor: Met-A rises with loss only while those sites stay above $\beta=\tfrac12$

entries.statement: WHAT THE READING IS ABOUT (the author, 2026-10-13): informational fidelity - order against disorder in the held pattern, as errors in INDIVIDUAL MOLECULES. It is not a reading of hardware. The gauge never sees an enzyme, a machine or a mechanism; it sees whether the pattern is still held, how far it has drifted, and whether the errors are isolated or run together. Naming a mechanism for a pattern of disorder is an INFERENCE MADE OUTSIDE THE PHYSICS and must be labelled as one wherever it appears. A lever is the handle pulled in an experiment; the reading is still only order against disorder, so no result may be stated as 'the gauge identified which machine failed' - only as 'these patterns of disorder are distinguishable at this depth, and a mechanism producing that pattern would be visible'.
entries.status: DERIVED from what the entropy reading is (a statement about the pattern, not its cause)
entries.anchor: \section{Margin per write, and fidelity per write}
entries.applies_at_every_scale: The author, 2026-10-13: 'The DNA is hardware, the sphere is the outcome, the patterns of order and disorder... the information.' So a genome-wide map must be built on the pattern, not on DNA addresses: a map whose coordinates are chromosome and position maps our filing system. See Biological_Physics/MethylPhys/doors/DEV_SPHERE_01.md.

entries.statement: WHICH WAY A FAILING CELL MOVES. Left of the healthy middle is MORE order than healthy; below the floor, H_min, identity can no longer be held - thermal kicks win. Senescent cells read on the left, below Normal (measured: they clean the unmethylated channel). RIGHT of the middle is the cell writing MORE error than healthy, toward the full surface - the 2D surface running out of room, the same side of the gauge as the supernova and the black hole. A CANCER CELL IS ON THE RIGHT: it has not lost its identity, it is over-writing. Identity loss is a left-side statement and must not be used for cancer.
entries.anchor: toward the full surface: the cell writing more

retired_foundations.statement: THE EIGHT-CLASS H_min FLOORS ARE RETIRED and are NOT part of this foundation. In the class gauge (GAPE era) the floor was a per-architecture-class constant, eight values fitted by MCMC over 37 reference cells, and A = H(beta)/H_min(class). The current chain does not use them: the floor is DERIVED from the Mahaffey number alone, eps_min = 1/(1+e^M), H_min = H(eps_min) (foundation entries `three_energies`, `h_min`). The eight classes were a definition borrowed from the quantum and semiconductor lines, not a result chosen by the MCMC - a point corrected from the record on 2026-09-28 - and the per-class band was a typed tolerance, not a measurement, in every class but one.
retired_foundations.why_recorded: The author's own warning: most contradictions he found later date from the era when each session had to be retaught, and the origin of the class floors is the clearest example. Recorded here so the lever chapter cannot re-import a retired fitted floor as if it were derived physics, and so anyone reading an old note knows which floor it means.
retired_foundations.status: RETIRED - do not use in any current reading, note or chapter

retired_numbers._rule: Class-era floor values. These were never derived and never measured: ten classes were suggested, eight were picked from the quantum and semiconductor lines, and an MCMC was then run on the eight, which returned numbers for them. Nothing in the current foundation uses or descends from them. foundation_check refuses any of these values in a file changed by a push, unless the line is marked '[retired wording kept for the record]' - so a class floor cannot come back by copy-paste. Scope (narrowed 2026-10-13): four-decimal values collide across a book that spans 37 orders of magnitude - 0.7998 is sigma_8 in the cosmology chains and 0.9050 a cluster-table value - so the check applies only to the cell's own files (Biological_Physics/MethylPhys/**, docs/book/part6, docs/book/part7) and, for the shorter values, only on a line that also mentions a floor, H_min, hmin or a class. The two six-decimal class floors are refused anywhere in those paths.

_layers: Every statement here is CORE or MEDIUM (the author, 2026-10-13). CORE is the law itself and is substrate-free: fidelity against a floor and a ceiling fixed by physics, the balance of restore and loss, M, phi, and what the reading is. The same core reads a qubit and a chip. MEDIUM is how a handle reaches the core's terms in one substrate - in a cell, enzymes, methyl supply, body temperature, oxygen. A lever that moves fidelity is a real lever, but it belongs to the medium, not to the core: change substrate and the levers change while the law does not. Consequence: a medium statement being wrong does not touch the law, and the law being wrong cannot be excused as a medium error. Each lever's falsifier must therefore say WHICH it would break.
